AppStatusEntry.description:
Per-app status/list entry rendered under `--output json`.

Built field-by-field from named accessors on `App` and `TokenStore`.
`From<&App>` and `Serialize`-on-`App` are forbidden: `App` holds
`client_secret`, OAuth2/OAuth1 tokens, and the bearer string, so
wholesale-forwarding would leak credentials.

A secret-exclusion test in `tests/cli_tests.rs` asserts no credential
field name or value appears in the rendered JSON.

bearer.description: Whether the app has a bearer token present (presence only).

client_id_hint.description: First 8 characters of `client_id` (never the full value, never `client_secret`).

default.description: Whether this app is the default.

oauth1.description: Whether the app has `OAuth1` credentials present (presence only).

oauth2_unnamed.description:
Whether the app has an unnamed (`/me`-failed salvage) `OAuth2` token.

Omitted from JSON output when `false` per KTD9 — a `true` value signals
that `App.unnamed_oauth2_token.is_some()`.

oauth2_users.description: `OAuth2` usernames present in the app (no tokens, just names).

redirect_uri.description: Effective `OAuth2` redirect URI from the resolver.

redirect_uri_stored.description: Stored per-app redirect URI; only present when the env var overrides it.

ResolveSource.description:
Origin of a resolved redirect URI.

Mirrors the upstream Go xurl labels at `config/config.go:62-72`.
The `#[serde(rename_all = "kebab-case")]` directive produces
`"env-var"`, `"app-config"`, and `"built-in-default"` in JSON output
(the machine-readable shape consumed by `--output json`); the
human-readable text rendering uses [`ResolveSource::as_text_label`].

oneOf.description: Resolved from the per-app value stored in `~/.xurl`.
